Scenario.Name: The Guard Chamber
Scenario.Summary: A lone swordsman and a cornered goblin, in one small room, with nowhere for either to go.

Room.Name: Guard Chamber
Room.Description: A cramped stone chamber below the old watchtower. The air is close and smells of damp and old smoke. The only door stands behind the intruder.
Features: A brazier of low coals burns against the eastern wall
A toppled wooden bench lies across one corner
Straw and gnawed bones are scattered over the flagstones

Characters.Name: Aric

Inventory.Name: Small Healing Potion
Inventory.Description: A stoppered vial of cloudy red liquid.

Injuries: Minor cut to the left forearm

Persona.Backstory: A sell-sword hired to clear the watchtower. You have done this work for years and it has stopped frightening you.
Persona.Personality: Brave, direct, and protective. You do not gloat and you do not waste words.
Persona.Wants: To finish this quickly and get out of the tower.
Persona.Fears: Being worn down slowly by something you underestimated.
Persona.Goal: Survive, and defeat or otherwise overcome the goblin.

Persona.Backstory: You have lived under this tower for two winters, and everything you own is in this room.
Persona.Personality: Cowardly, spiteful and opportunistic. You bluster when frightened and strike when you think you can get away with it.
Persona.Wants: To drive the intruder away without having to fight them fairly.
Persona.Fears: Dying here, alone, on the stones.
Persona.Goal: Drive the intruder out and survive.
